answer: Every palm in the oasis carries its owner's brand burned into the trunk, and the fruit is weighed at harvest against the registry's own figures. A ridge palm planted in secret fails the registry: at the crystal of the harvest the brand must match the book the keeper holds, and an unbranded palm bears no claim. Forging a palm means bribing the keeper, planting 200 palms and paying 18,200, while the delta brand on the trunk is checked yearly, so a palm whose brand was never entered is cut down.
